revision_rounds.issue: Draft design lacked a source-specific model for H3 and an ex ante occupational grouping for H4.
revision_rounds.action_taken: Added M4 (source indicators vs fossil) and M5 (five SOC-based occupational groups fixed ex ante).

revision_rounds.issue: Trend claims vulnerable to OEWS three-year pooling.
revision_rounds.action_taken: Added linear-trend specification and blueprint language treating trends as smoothed; joint Wald test for year interactions.
Added three alternative categorizations and leave-one-source-out to robustness plan.

revision_rounds.issue: Fixed-effects design required a scholar-causal audit; causal gate was initially recorded as not required.
revision_rounds.action_taken: Invoked scholar-causal; wrote design/causal-audit.md and design/diagnostic_plan.json; set causal_gate required=true, invoked=true; added suppression-share diagnostic.

revision_rounds.issue: Model-spec predictor/covariate names did not match variable-dictionary constructs; percentile outcomes combined in one model.
revision_rounds.action_taken: Renamed model terms to dictionary constructs, recorded interactions explicitly, split M8 into M8 (P10) and M9 (P90).

revision_rounds.issue: The word 'classification' (industry categories) caused a downstream method-family detector to treat the design as supervised machine learning.
revision_rounds.action_taken: Renamed to 'categorization' in design, diagnostic and spec-registry text; no change to models or samples.
